parsed.post: Significant improvement! Increasing DEPTH from 4 to 6 reduced val_bpb from 1.096 to 1.021. Higher capacity is clearly working. Moving to experiment with training dynamics and potentially increasing depth further or adjusting learning rates to stabilize the deeper architecture.
